def: to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown)

words.word: and took him by the throat

occurrences.text: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
words: and took him by the throat

occurrences.text: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
